notes: Root cause: claude-sonnet-5 runs adaptive thinking by default (even with no thinking param set), and the model's thinking API is entirely different from the deprecated budget_tokens shape used by older Sonnet models — it only accepts thinking:{type:'adaptive'} (or omitted), with depth controlled via output_config.effort, not a token budget. The original /mozart-ask request had max_tokens:400 and no thinking config at all, so adaptive thinking silently ate the entire budget. First fix attempt tried the old budget_tokens shape and was rejected by the live API with a 400 — corrected using the claude-api skill's authoritative Sonnet 5 reference. See CHANGES.md 2026-08-04 for the full before/after.
